text: A pill with a pulsing status dot and a label for service states: online, offline, maintenance or degraded. loop css dashboard motion status dot uptime service online

name: unlock-face-id
title: Unlock Face ID
text: A Face ID style unlock: brackets and a face draw themselves, a scan line sweeps, then a check reveals the blurred content behind it. Controlled or self-running. click svg motion face id unlock biometric scan reveal

name: ai-reasoning
title: AI Reasoning
text: A collapsible reasoning trace. The summary shimmers only while the model is working, then settles, reports how long it took and folds away. click svg ai motion ai reasoning collapsible streaming

name: ai-reasoning
title: AI Reasoning · Streaming
text: Open and shimmering while the model is still reasoning.

name: ai-reasoning
title: AI Reasoning · Collapsed
text: A finished trace folded down to its one-line summary.

name: ai-tool-approval
title: AI Tool Approval
text: A card where the user approves or denies an agent's tool call, showing the command or fields, the reason, and a polite live announcement of the decision. click svg ai motion ai agent approval tool-call

name: ai-tool-approval
title: AI Tool Approval · Approved
text: The settled state after the reader approves the command.

name: ai-tool-approval
title: AI Tool Approval · Denied
text: The settled state after the reader denies a risky command.

name: ai-tool-approval
title: AI Tool Approval · Field list
text: A structured call whose input shows as labelled fields instead of a command.

name: uptime-card
title: Uptime Card
text: A status card with a row of daily bars per service, an uptime percentage and a short list of recent incidents. Bars are readable by screen readers and inspectable with the keyboard. hover css dashboard motion status uptime monitoring incidents

name: uptime-card
title: Uptime Card · Two weeks
text: Fourteen wide bars per service for a short, readable window.

name: uptime-card
title: Uptime Card · Ninety days
text: A dense strip of ninety thin bars for a long history.

name: terminal
title: Terminal
text: A terminal window that plays its lines in sequence: typed commands and fading output. Shows everything at once under reduced motion. in-view css motion terminal cli typing

name: terminal
title: Terminal · Parallel lines
text: Lines run on their own delays instead of waiting for the one before, so the output lands almost at once.

name: candlestick-chart
title: Candlestick Chart
text: OHLC candles with volume bars, a last-price line and a keyboard-friendly crosshair readout, drawn in plain SVG. hover svg web3 motion candles ohlc price trading chart

name: order-book
title: Order Book
text: A depth ladder with asks above and bids below, cumulative depth bars, a spread bar and a fill-cost readout on hover. Driven by snapshots passed as props. loop css web3 dashboard motion order book depth trading dex

name: order-book
title: Order Book · Top of book
text: Only the three nearest levels on each side, for a compact ticket.

name: price-ticker
title: Price Ticker
text: A price that rolls its digits on every update, flashes green or red, and shows a percent change badge. loop svg web3 motion price digits live

name: price-ticker
title: Price Ticker · Falling
text: A price below its 24h open, so the change badge reads as a loss.

name: price-ticker
title: Price Ticker · Price only
text: Just the rolling digits, with the change badge hidden.

name: volume-profile
title: Volume Profile
text: Volume traded at each price level as horizontal bars, with the point of control, value area and an inspect-by-keyboard readout, in plain SVG. hover svg web3 motion volume profile poc value area price levels

name: address-chip
title: Address Chip
text: A compact EVM address with a generated blockie-style avatar, copy button, ENS label and explorer link. click svg web3 motion lucide address wallet copy

name: address-chip
title: Address Chip · Bare
text: Only the shortened address as plain text, with no avatar and no copy button.

name: wallet-card
title: Wallet Card
text: A stack of payment-style cards with a pointer sheen: pick one to bring it forward, mask the balance and see who shares it. click hover web3 motion wallet card balance account stack

name: currency-transfer
title: Currency Transfer
text: A transfer receipt that follows money through four steps, rolls the amount into the new currency and offers a copyable reference. loop click web3 motion transfer currency convert receipt status swap

name: receipt-printer
title: Receipt Printer
text: A transaction receipt (hash, from, to, amount, fee, status) that feeds out of a printer slot one line at a time, with a serrated edge. in-view css web3 motion receipt transaction print

name: receipt-printer
title: Receipt Printer · Manual print
text: The paper stays in the printer until the Print button is pressed.

name: receipt-printer
title: Receipt Printer · Failed
text: A receipt for a transaction that failed on chain.

name: swap-panel
title: Swap Panel
text: A cross-chain swap ticket: pay and receive fields, a token picker with chain filter, a live quote and an optional destination address. click type web3 motion swap exchange token dex bridge quote

name: tx-steps
title: Transaction Steps
text: Step-by-step transaction status (Approve, Sign, Broadcast, Confirmed) with a spinning active step, checkmarks and error state. in-view svg web3 motion lucide stepper transaction status

name: tx-steps
title: Transaction Steps · Vertical
text: The steps stacked in a column with a connecting line, mid-swap.

name: tx-steps
title: Transaction Steps · Failed step
text: A row of steps where the wallet rejection stops the flow on an error state.

name: amount-pad
title: Amount Pad
text: A number pad for entering a token amount: animated digits, presets, a per-transfer cap, shake on refusal and physical keyboard input. click svg web3 motion amount keypad input send

name: amount-pad
title: Amount Pad · Dollar prefix
text: A currency pad with the symbol in front of the amount and two decimals.

name: amount-pad
title: Amount Pad · Whole units
text: A whole-number pad with no decimal key, for tokens that are not divisible.

name: amount-stepper
title: Amount Stepper
text: Minus, amount and plus in one inline control: decimal steps, min and max, and a ticker label for token amounts. click web3 motion amount stepper quantity input token

name: hero-section
title: Hero Section
text: Landing hero with an eyebrow pill, headline, copy, two calls to action and an optional media slot, revealed in a soft stagger. in-view css marketing motion lucide landing hero cta

name: /components/text
title: Text
text: Letters that roll, scramble, reveal and shine.

name: /components/backgrounds
title: Backgrounds
text: Quiet fields of light, grids and shaders behind your content.

name: /components/cursor
title: Cursor
text: Pointer-aware pull, light and trails. Off on touch screens.

name: /components/buttons
title: Buttons
text: Buttons that shimmer, slide and ask before they act.

name: /components/cards
title: Cards
text: Surfaces that react to hover, flip and glow.

name: /components/inputs
title: Inputs
text: Fields, sliders, pickers and pads with a bit of physics.

name: /components/navigation
title: Navigation
text: Docks, tabs, menus and command bars.

name: /components/overlays
title: Overlays
text: Layers above the page: dialogs, lenses and blur.

name: /components/layout
title: Layout
text: Lists, carousels, accordions, marquees and grids in motion.

name: /components/scroll
title: Scroll
text: Progress, reveals and parallax tied to the scroll position.

name: /components/feedback
title: Feedback
text: Loaders, skeletons, progress and status that say what is happening.

name: /components/ai
title: AI
text: Chat, reasoning and agent states for AI products.

name: /components/data
title: Data
text: Charts, stats and status pages in plain SVG and CSS.

name: /components/media
title: Media
text: Galleries, device mock-ups and players.

name: /components/onchain
title: On-chain
text: Prices, addresses and transaction states. Data in, no RPC.

name: /blocks/marketing
title: Marketing
text: Sections for landing pages, from navbar to footer.
